context: Implementation of the 8-item growth/retention feature package from the game-expert review, targeting option B (public PR/mascot game, not a commercial IAP product).

features.1_daily_reengagement_loop: Calendar-date-based attendance streak (separate from the existing repeatable 4-action daily reward, left untouched). Consecutive days increase the bonus from 100G to 700G on day 7, then cycles. Triggers once per real day on game start.
features.2_onboarding: 5-step tutorial modal shown once on a brand-new save's first start, covering movement/interaction/shop/farm.
features.3_level_gated_unlocks: Added unlock-level requirements to all 12 seeds and 5 upgrades. Locked items show a lock icon and disabled button; purchase functions double-check the requirement themselves too.
features.4_ranking_wired_up: Added functions/api/ranking-submit.js and wired score submission into the existing 20-second heartbeat cycle. The ranking panel now shows a real top-50 leaderboard from the previously-unused functions/api/ranking.js, with a graceful logged-out fallback.
features.5_sound: Procedural Web Audio API sound effects (no files needed) for harvest, purchase, planting, level-up, mission success/failure, notifications, and car collision. Scope note: SFX only, not full background music.
features.6_gameover_redesign: Replaced the hard game-over screen with a softer consequence: a 10% gold penalty (min 50G) plus 3 seconds of invincibility, no reload required.
features.7_viral_hook: First use of any share channel grants a one-time 300G bonus, tracked so it can't repeat.
features.8_weather_linked_events: The first time it becomes rainy or snowy on a given day, the player gets a one-time bonus (150G rain, 250G snow). Scope note: gameplay reward only, not the cosmetic umbrella-NPC visual.

verification.syntax: node --check passes on game.js, game-systems.js, and ranking-submit.js.
verification.existing_regression_suite_rerun: JS syntax check, road-graph integrity, the stuck-at-node escape test, the speed-equalization test, and a standard headless-browser playthrough (updated to dismiss the new tutorial/attendance modals) all pass with only the expected harmless local-CORS weather-fetch errors.
verification.new_feature_flows_tested: Attendance streak/bonus, tutorial gating, level-gated shop locking (including blocking a direct purchase attempt), ranking panel logged-out fallback, and share-reward one-time-claim were all directly tested in a live browser.

deployment_note_important: schema.sql was not changed this round (ranking-submit.js reuses the existing rankings table from v37), but it still needs to be applied once if the D1 database predates that table.
